versions.subject: Update proc_creation_win_nslookup_poweshell_download.yml
versions.detection:
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'powershell .'
        - 'nslookup'
        - ' -q=txt '
selection_img:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    Image|contains: '\nslookup.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' -q=txt '
condition: 1 of selection_*
